thread:
Mia (AE): Hi team — MedCorp wants a short eval POC. Requirements: hosted ephemeral API keys, $2.5k trial credits, hard spend cap, and per-minute quotas for embeddings + generation. Can infra spin up a billing project and confirm what we can lock down?
Omar (SE): Need rough workload details: mainly embeddings? batch sizes? any model restrictions (HIPAA-safe models)?
Leo (MedCorp POC): Mostly embeddings for clinical search, occasional generation for demo scripts. Expect ~6 rps steady with bursts to 12 rps. Batch size ~32. Keys should expire after 12 days.
Tessa (Infra): We can provision a sandbox project. Our standard sandbox can include $2,500 free credits. For hard caps finance needs to approve — we can set $7,000 as an enforced cap if requested. We also support spend alerts (30/60/90%). Ephemeral keys TTL 12d OK.
Hannah (Finance): For healthcare customers we require invoice hold and manual overage approvals. $2.5k credit + $7k hard cap is fine; set approvals to route to Mia + Hannah.
Omar (SE): Quota suggestions for MedCorp: embeddings_calls_per_minute=250, embeddings_batch_max=64, gen_tokens_per_minute=8000, concurrent_requests=6. Also whitelist models: text-embed-clinical-001 and redwood-chat-med-small.
Tessa (Infra): I'll create project and attach the whitelist/quotas. Internal payload (for visibility):
```
POST /internal/projects
{
  "name": "medcorp-eval-poc",
  "org_id": "medcorp-11",
  "free_credits_usd": "2500",
  "hard_cap_usd": "7000",
  "alerts": ["30%","60%","90%"],
  "key_ttl_days": "12",
  "allowed_models": ["text-embed-clinical-001","redwood-chat-med-small"],
  "quotas": {"embeddings_calls_per_minute": "250","embeddings_batch_max": "64","gen_tokens_per_minute": "8000","concurrent_requests": "6"}
}
```
Tessa (Infra): Kicking it off now. Will post project id + ephemeral key when ready.
provision-bot: Created project medcorp-eval-poc (proj_f4b2). Generated ephemeral key sk-ephem-med-9a8b (expires 2026-06-11). Dashboard: https://console.redwood/projects/proj_f4b2
Hannah (Finance): Billing code MED-EVAL-2026 assigned. Invoice hold applied. Overage approvals routed to Mia + Hannah.
Mia (AE): Leo, you should have a DM with the key and dashboard. Can you run a quick embeddings smoke test and confirm access?
Leo (MedCorp POC): Got the key. Smoke test passed. One ask: for the perf window tomorrow can we relax gen_tokens_per_minute briefly for a 45-min run? I'll provide exact numbers.
Omar (SE): Yes — we can schedule a temporary quota bump in a controlled test window. Please post expected token volume and time.
Mia (AE): I'll coordinate timing and approvals. Marking provisioning complete; follow-up in separate thread for the perf bump. :thumbsup:
